RPC waits authentic agent_settled before reading durable history or issuing subsequent prompts. Foreign model projection converts visible thinking to text and omits opaque/redacted fields without editing original message rows. Returning to the owner and context-editing the first assistant clears only that target projected reasoning; later owner signatures survive, the intervening foreign-model output stays expurgated, original raw assistant rows remain unchanged, and the tool executes once.
